# Kindred E-Commerce Merchant Deals Dataset

A structured, open-access dataset of global E-Commerce merchant deals and offers designed specifically for LLM training, 
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, machine learning models, and natural language processing applications.

This dataset includes curated promotional offers from a wide range of online retailers and marketplaces, 
with structured metadata including offer descriptions, redemption URLs, brand information, and geolocation tags.

## Key Features
- RAG-optimized with sample_q fields designed for prompt engineering and training
- Multi-format data available in both CSV and JSONL with validated JSON Schema
- Comprehensive brand and offer metadata for building knowledge graphs
- Machine learning ready data across multiple retail verticals
- No personally identifiable information (PII) included
